regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: The DOS EXE header, rebuilt by the museum's unpacker after removing the DIET compression.

regions.label: Header gap
regions.note: Four zero bytes before the relocation table.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 158 addresses that DOS patches with the real load segment when the program starts.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Zeros that round the header up to a 16-byte paragraph.

regions.label: Borland C++ startup and runtime
regions.note: Start-up code, getch and the stack check.

regions.label: main()
regions.note: The whole editor: 571 bytes of C with inline assembly for every ARABART call.

regions.label: Padding
regions.note: Zeros up to the next 16-byte segment.

regions.label: Borland graphics library (BGI)
regions.note: initgraph, cleardevice, closegraph and the code that loads EGAVGA.BGI.

regions.label: Borland data
regions.note: The "Borland C++ - Copyright 1991" string and runtime variables.

regions.label: His buffers
regions.note: An empty driver path at DS:0092, the text buffer at DS:0093 and the copy that is drawn at DS:00EF.

regions.label: Borland data
regions.note: Graphics library tables, the driver name EGAVGA and its error texts.

regions.label: Uninitialized variables
regions.note: Zeros in the file; variables that start at 0 (BSS).

regions.label: Stack
regions.note: 128 bytes, from SS:SP 066B:0080 in the header.
